name: cipherforces-print
description: Real print prices from CipherForces for business cards, flyers, brochures, postcards, stickers and labels, with a link to order on cipherforces.com.

interface.longDescription: Get the real price for business cards, foil business cards, flyers, tri-fold brochures, postcards, paper stickers, roll labels and die-cut vinyl stickers from CipherForces, a Los Angeles print and design studio. Tell ChatGPT what you need (for example "500 business cards, both sides" or "100 vinyl stickers, 3 by 3 inches") and CipherForces Print shows the price, the price per piece, a few other quantities to compare, and the paper or material. When you are ready, the order link opens the same product on cipherforces.com at the same price, where you design your piece online, upload your own file, or have a designer make it, then choose shipping or local pickup. CipherForces Print only quotes: it never places an order, takes a payment, or asks for personal details.
capabilities: Prices business cards, foil cards, flyers, brochures, postcards, stickers and roll labels
